items.summary: Four years of electronics that mostly taught me how much I'd rather be in a timeline. The degree finished; the editing had already taken over.

items.role: Video Editor + Graphic Designer + Motion Graphics Animator + Content Producer
items.summary: Started as the channel's editor and left as the person who ran its content: scripting, recording, cutting, packaging and publishing across YouTube and Instagram. Five years, one channel, every job in the pipeline.
Independent practice for brands and creators: the edit, the motion, the grade, and the call on what's worth cutting in the first place.

milestones.title: Left the engineering track
milestones.summary: Final semester of an electronics degree, mid-pandemic, and the job that turned up was a content job. Took it, and never went back to circuits.

milestones.title: Started writing and recording
milestones.summary: Stopped only cutting other people's footage. Started writing and recording it myself for Bharat in Germany: script, voice, edit, publish, one pair of hands.

milestones.title: Freelancing in earnest
milestones.summary: The side practice stopped being occasional. A regular freelance load ran alongside the full-time role: brand films, music videos, cutdowns.

milestones.title: 200 shorts deep
milestones.summary: Two hundred vertical videos for Bharat in Germany, written, recorded, cut and published. The volume that turns instinct into a system.

milestones.title: At the German Embassy
milestones.summary: Shot and cut an interview with the spokesperson of the German Embassy — the channel's first institutional sit-down.

milestones.title: Bangalore, in person
milestones.summary: Organised an on-ground event in Bangalore for students and parents planning a move to Germany. The audience off the feed and in one room.

milestones.title: Went independent
milestones.summary: Left the job after five years to edit and strategise full-time, on my own terms.
